description: This source file defines the UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint class, which implements an HTTP endpoint for updating catalog items via a minimal API in ASP.NET Core. It handles route registration, authorization, and the logic to update and respond with the updated catalog item data.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Handles the HTTP PUT endpoint to update catalog items, including route setup, request handling, authorization, and updating the entity in the repository.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the route for the HTTP PUT operation to update catalog items, setting up authorization and linking the request handler.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the update request by retrieving the existing catalog item, updating its properties, saving changes, and returning the appropriate HTTP response.
